inheritance_schema.description: Resolve entry_defaults then ordered profiles then local overrides. Missing local fields inherit; never infer completed/unused/approved.
inheritance_schema.symbols: Member = class.surface_symbol + (static ? '.' : '.prototype.') + name. Option = class.surface_symbol + '.options.' + name.
inheritance_schema.anchors: Entry line inherits parent file.path. Nested helper line inherits v1/src/natural.ui.js; other refs carry path.
inheritance_schema.profiles: Each entry.profiles resolves concrete owner/current/status/source_refs/acceptance/existing_test_sources. First profile is primary owner; all extra owners stay required. Local current refines equivalence.
inheritance_schema.reachability: Parent class.reachability_refs plus defaults apply; consult static_reference_index by reconstructed symbol. No indexed chain never means unused.
inheritance_schema.count_boundary: Nested helpers and declaration/config/dynamic keys stay separate from exact structural class/member/literal-option counts.
inheritance_schema.classes: Class/member/option kind is a typed inventory identity; class/member symbol collision such as NU.grid alias versus excluded nested class is intentional. Each member/option inherits class reachability_refs.
inheritance_schema.defaults: Defaults supply required/open/no-approved-retirement policy. Every profile supplies concrete owner/current/status/source refs/acceptance; an entry override refines only that field. Literal defaults are extracted syntax, not current API defaults.
inheritance_schema.dynamic_entries: additional_dynamic_paths and nested_helpers inherit entry_defaults and profiles. Dynamic acceptance adds to profile acceptance; no external declaration/config key is counted as a constructor literal.
inheritance_schema.document_hashes: Legacy and current code fingerprints describe exact files at audit time. Markdown fingerprints are audit-time references and may change during parent indexing/stamping.
inheritance_schema.external_entries: An external_declarations interface or external_configuration group supplies profiles and source path; nested fields/paths inherit that ownership/current/status/acceptance and entry_defaults. These records never enter exact inventory counts. Call shapes are declaration text, not proof of shipped API.

retirement.policy: Preserve supported behavior or replace private mechanism; supported retirement needs one consolidated user decision.

entry_defaults.legacy_fault_policy: Preserve useful intended shipped outcomes, not documented faults or commented TODO APIs.

U01.current: bindForm rows/rules/parse and bind/read/validate; nested native radio/checkbox/multiple Select raw/display/drafts. Image src and authored rich display are absent.
acceptance: Preserve complete native input/group types, typed raw values and nested writes with unique scoped label/ARIA IDs.
Add image src/inert authored rich rendering with text default; prove shared Form/List/Grid control equivalence.

U02.current: Rows add/remove/revert/set and Form.bind(RowId|null)/read exist; authored-default reset, indexed insert and add from entered values are incomplete.
acceptance: Distinguish clear binding, authored-default reset, stored-row revert and draft disposal.
Create/insert from current/default fields without changing unrelated IDs; verify status, notifications and failure rollback.

U03.current: RuleSet/parse and explicit initialization exist; per-value/per-bind hooks, veto/observation and global/local composition are absent.
acceptance: Preserve local-then-global ordering, value transforms and actual call-site false effects; onBefore naming alone does not prove veto.
Crosswalk row-before/after and completed initial/append/update bind hooks; resolve declarations, locale, dependencies and cleanup.

U04.current: bindList select/selected/setSort/setFilter/setPage/page/validate/dispose displays Rows; row-click/unselect and legacy projections remain open.
acceptance: Crosswalk data/context/bind through authored templates and immutable stable Rows IDs.
Prove row-click/toggle/unselect, callback context and selected projections through sort/filter/page/mutation/rebind.

U05.current: List disables bound controls and rejects radio; it displays/validates without editable draft/commit support.
acceptance: Edit List fields with shared native groups/parse/rules/typed choices/drafts, including val/update and row Form workflows.
Preserve readonly/disabled behavior, cross-field validation, invalid recovery/reveal and shared Rows synchronization.

U06.current: Single selected RowId only; multiple selection, separate check state, scoped check-all/exclusive checks and before-select veto are absent.
acceptance: Keep selected IDs and checked IDs distinct across view/store changes; define visible/filtered/store check-all and mixed/exclusive state.
Honor actual selection veto/callback results and disabled rows with pointer/keyboard ranges and typed result projections.

U07.current: Rows CRUD exists; indexed List add/move/independent-copy/add-select/append completion is incomplete.
acceptance: Insert/move/copy at explicit positions while preserving unrelated IDs and independent nested values.
Select/reveal added rows as requested; prove completion, notification and rollback behavior.

U08.current: Local setPage and authored overflow/dimensions exist; progressive scroll, delayed rows, height drag and action-driven reveal are absent.
acceptance: Preserve progressive scroll/createRowDelay/append; local paging is not true virtualization.
Provide height resize, containment and add/select/check/invalid reveal with keyboard paths and stable ID/draft/callback cleanup.

U09.current: bindSelect choices/value/onChange with setChoices/setValue/value/dispose supports native single/multiple raw choices; mutation/index/reset/append recipes need proof.
acceptance: Preserve typed scalar/null and authored defaults while replacing/appending/removing choices.
Crosswalk index/value/reset-first/default overloads, missing/duplicate choices, multiple selections and exact disposal.

U10.current: Form static groups exist; Select generates no radio/checkbox item/label groups.
acceptance: Instantiate authored radio/checkbox templates with unique label IDs and instance-scoped names.
Support direction/raw choices/append/remove/reset/single-multiple values, keyboard labels, row-control reuse and teardown.

U11.current: bindPagination state/onPage and set/state/dispose exist; numeric window is fixed and configurable page-set windows/jumps are absent.
acceptance: Crosswalk totalCount/pageNo/countPerPage, positive bounds, empty/clamped results and bind callback suppression.
Support countPerPageSet/previous-next set/currPageNavInfo with accessible keyboard controls and controlled Grid/List state.

U12.current: No bindButton export; native disabled and authored CSS/actions replace wrappers. Anchor blocking and creation hooks need proof.
acceptance: Disable/enable buttons and action links for keyboard/pointer with accessible state.
Preserve creation-hook/style workflow, per-instance owned listeners and cleanup without a mandatory framework theme.

U13.current: openPopup supports modal ready/result/close/dispose; no reusable Alert/confirm binder/full legacy outcomes and hooks.
acceptance: Preserve localized message/confirm OK/cancel outcomes, actual veto effects and lifecycle order.
Crosswalk backdrop/Escape/close modes/failure; restore opener/focus/owned DOM across show/hide/remove and independent instances.

U14.current: Field issue rendering exists; arbitrary scoped element/input messages, arrays/vars/expiry/blocking are absent.
acceptance: Support arbitrary input/element/window scopes, arrays, substitutions, inert rich content and blocking.
Provide optional accessible expiry/user dismissal with localized relations, visible focus and exact replacement/removal cleanup.

U15.current: Native dialog/top layer and authored geometry replace correction/z-index machinery; nonmodal, retained reopen and title drag are absent.
acceptance: Preserve modal/nonmodal/hide-retain/reopen state and lifecycle.
Provide bounded title dragging with keyboard operation, resize/scroll/containment; replace correction pixels only with equivalent tested outcomes.

U16.current: openPopup(dialog,PageDefinition,input) gives one opening ready/result/close/dispose; preload/retained reopen/controller access are absent.
acceptance: Support preload/retained close-reopen/stateless recreation without duplicate init.
Preserve opener/input/output/load-open-close order through failure/abort and shared view transport; retain approved ESM and executable HTML refusal.

U17.current: bindTabs initial/pages/errorText and ready/select/selected/dispose lazily retain successful pages; live enable/disable/preload/stateless/activation input are absent.
acceptance: Crosswalk EachTab url/active/preload/onOpen/disable/stateless and per-activation data/order.
Reconcile active disabled focus, retain/recreate/fail/retry policies, overflow reveal and keyboard/pointer teardown.

U18.current: bindTree key(identity)/parent/rules/onSelect and select/selected/setExpanded/expanded/dispose exist; folder/label toggle and all-expand policies need closure.
acceptance: Crosswalk legacy key(label), val(identity), parent/level without copying data IDs to DOM IDs.
Prove folder/leaf select/icon-label toggle, expand/collapse-all/first-root, hierarchy keyboard/typeahead/mutation/isolation.

U19.current: No current checkbox/cascade/mixed contract. Legacy bind-installed events and onCheck leaf collections exist; check/val/update are commented TODOs.
acceptance: Preserve descendant cascade/parent mixed state, row/context/data/leaf results and change flag with stable IDs.
Add keyboard checking and mutation/rebind cleanup; do not invent public legacy methods or copy pointer-coordinate-only callback gating.

U20.current: Controlled ISO value/min/max/locale/weekStartsOn/onChange and value/setValue/focus/dispose exist; attachment/show-hide/veto workflows are absent.
acceptance: Provide owned explicit/declarative input attachment and typed/display synchronization with min/max/locale feedback.
Preserve show/hide/select return effects, Form validation, focus, independent instances and disposal.

U21.current: Day calendar previous/next month and keyboard days exist; month-only, year/month panels, holidays and swipe/wheel period navigation are absent.
acceptance: Support month-only YYYY-MM, direct year/month input/panels/windows and bounds.
Preserve named repeating/once holidays, localized feedback and touch/wheel gestures with owned accessible alternatives.

U22.current: bindNotify show(text,{urgent}) returns dismissal with clear/dispose/live channels; rich content, actions/URL callbacks and optional expiry are absent.
acceptance: Preserve useful rich content through inert authored templates and explicit actions/URLs/functions.
Provide optional accessible user-controlled expiry, focus-safe dismissal/canceled timers, localized labels/placement/stacking and urgent/polite announcements.

U23.current: bindDocuments beforeClose/errorText and open/select/selected/keys/close/reload/dispose provide retained keyed MDI; SDI and complete context/Request/per-entry hooks are absent.
acceptance: Crosswalk MDI/SDI/duplicate keys/activation/reload and per-entry input/output/controller/request metadata.
Preserve actual load/active/inactive/close hook order/veto and inherited attr/removeAttr/param/get plus route/history recipes.

U24.current: Current Documents appends entries and closes whole entries; capacity/state eviction/insertion/close-all/menu/reveal are absent.
acceptance: Support maxTabs/maxStateful, retained-entry state eviction/reload and guard/cancel/refusal outcomes.
Preserve insertion/order/close-all-except-active/redirect/menu and overflow keyboard reveal; release evicted page resources.

U25.current: Comm/Page cancellation exist; no document-scoped request aggregate/exclusion/progress/error/reset/blocking owner.
acceptance: Track concurrent owned requests/exclusions/counters/progress and deterministic error/complete reset with callbacks/blocking.
Handle abort/reload/close/background/multi-shell independently without global filter leakage.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: Namespace imports, receiver factories and aliases
additional_dynamic_paths.observed: NU/NUS receiver methods forward to nested constructors. Declaration/global/prototype aliases and external computed component names make partial static reference sets insufficient. NU.grid root aliases remain mapped here; its nested class belongs to Grid evidence.
additional_dynamic_paths.acceptance: Crosswalk public behavior to explicit ESM binders/controllers and migration recipes; retain aliases in the structural set and resolve external callsites without restoring implicit executable page globals.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: External configuration, localization and nested defaults
additional_dynamic_paths.observed: Constructor literals are only an initial subset. N.context.attr merges component options, nested button styles, alert.input.displayTimeout/closeBtn, monthonlyOpts, locale messages, date/week/month/holiday presentation and Shell menu/capacity labels. Core checked/unchecked and split separator settings reach Form/Select.
additional_dynamic_paths.acceptance: Resolve every external_configuration path and locale label to profile-owned explicit configuration/authored content. Prove precedence, caller override isolation and locale fallback; a syntax inventory never establishes behavioral closure.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: Local/global lifecycle composition and actual return effects
additional_dynamic_paths.observed: wrapHandler invokes local then global. Local false prevents the wrapped global callback except onBeforeBindValue, whose local transformed result is passed to global. Each consumer decides whether false affects its action; not every onBefore callsite vetoes.
additional_dynamic_paths.acceptance: Write phase/argument/receiver/order/transformed-value and actual false-effect cases for every profile; do not infer veto from a callback name.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: Authored context, registered instance lookup and controller exposure
additional_dynamic_paths.observed: Components keep options.context and data-backed named instance/controller aliases. Template p.component.id dispatch and cont/view relationships permit external instance retrieval or context setter overloads.
additional_dynamic_paths.acceptance: Map use cases to scoped authored HTMLElement, explicit handles and PageContext/root/own. Document lookup/rebinding/disposal behavior and prove two independent roots with duplicate business field keys.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: Shared Form row controls and nested bindEvents methods
additional_dynamic_paths.observed: Form.bindEvents contains validate/dataSync/enterKey/format functions outside class-member inventory. List creates row Forms with extObj/extRow and installs a parent dataSync bridge. Grid shares the same helpers.
additional_dynamic_paths.acceptance: Crosswalk nested methods, raw/display conversion, Enter behavior, row identities, data/status notifications, error rollback and hidden/offscreen/control cleanup across Form/List/Grid.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: Shared nested iteration, drag and progressive-scroll helpers
additional_dynamic_paths.observed: NU.ui exposes twelve object-nested helper functions beyond its four structural object members. Direct callsites span List/Grid rendering, selection/checking, move/copy, drag resize/chrome and scroll batches.
additional_dynamic_paths.acceptance: Use nested_helpers to close all caller-visible effects, replacing private mechanics only after reachability and behavior proof. Paging/progressive appending does not satisfy true virtual-window acceptance.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: EachTab nested entry options absent from constructor literals
additional_dynamic_paths.observed: EachTab declares url,active,preload,onOpen,disable,stateless; tabOpts entries are consumed by load/open paths. Constructor path tabOpts alone would hide these supported behaviors.
additional_dynamic_paths.acceptance: Prove first activation/preload order, initial active selection, live disabling, stateless recreation, per-entry opening data/hook args, overflow reveal and cleanup.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: Popup/Tab page opening data and returned controllers
additional_dynamic_paths.observed: Popup onOpen/onClose data may be functions/named controller methods; Tab open/cont exposes loaded content/controller. Template defers onOpen until component initialization finishes.
additional_dynamic_paths.acceptance: Use explicit page input/result/controller recipes while preserving useful asynchronous ordering, load failure/retry, disposal, preloaded/retained state and callback composition; forbid execution of fetched inline scripts.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: Documents per-entry metadata and combined lifecycle
additional_dynamic_paths.observed: DocOpts adds docId/docNm/url/urlSync/stateless and entry before/after load/active/inactive/removeState/remove callbacks beyond shell constructor literals. Entry and shell hooks combine; tab removal differs from loaded-state removal.
additional_dynamic_paths.acceptance: Map metadata/key/title/url resolution and PageContext.input explicitly. Test global/entry order and callsite veto, state unload versus close, stateless reinit and failed navigation cleanup.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: DocumentsRequest inherited fluent request facade
additional_dynamic_paths.observed: Documents creates self.request through NA.Request with Documents-specific get behavior; types expose attr/removeAttr/param/get and inherit Documents operations. This surface is dynamic rather than an NUS.docs class member.
additional_dynamic_paths.acceptance: Provide a typed explicit page input/communicator recipe with parameters/attributes/URL synchronization; close its loading, hooks, abort/error and scoped aggregation effects rather than claiming openDocuments alone is equivalent.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: Scoped request filter aggregation and exclude rules
additional_dynamic_paths.observed: docsFilter__ is installed into architecture comm filters when callbacks, indicator or blocking require it. It tracks request counts/max, excludes URLs, handles error/reset and includes loadedDocId in completion hooks.
additional_dynamic_paths.acceptance: Implement scoped request begin/progress/end/error/abort accounting, excludes and optional blocking. Verify concurrency, zero/negative protection, failures, cleanup and no cross-shell interference; timers and whole-shell loading remain required.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: Formatter-triggered DatePicker/MonthPicker attachment
additional_dynamic_paths.observed: Date/month formatter arguments attach a picker dynamically to eligible input controls and preserve format/display conversion. Direct datepicker constructor references alone cannot close this indirect Form/List/Grid path.
additional_dynamic_paths.acceptance: Preserve date/month editing outcomes with explicit composed bindings, raw/display rules, bounds/locale and disposal; cover initial fields and dynamically created/offscreen row controls.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: Authored templates, declaration bindings, code choices and rule messages
additional_dynamic_paths.observed: Template p.* declarations instantiate components through computed receiver names, resolve view-scoped field IDs, code/choice data, defaults and event initialization. Legacy example-template Markdown contains authored HTML/CVC snippets; historical linked remote HTML is not assumed locally present.
additional_dynamic_paths.acceptance: Crosswalk authored snippet workflows to explicit scoped CVC templates, data-field paths, caller-owned business initialization, choice loading and localized rules. Preserve outcome without DOM IDs for business field keys; inventory external templates/callers before closure.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: Select generated groups, overloads, default/reset and selection projections
additional_dynamic_paths.observed: Select binds native selects or radio/checkbox templates, direction/type/append, index/value overloads, removal and reset. Static Form groups cover authored input values but do not generate data-driven choice groups.
additional_dynamic_paths.acceptance: Test all source label/raw value types, append/removal/reindexing, defaults/reset, single/multiple/index/value behavior and events, including generated label/ARIA identity and disposal.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: Form authored defaults, field types and reset/create/update overloads
additional_dynamic_paths.observed: Form captures InitialData, classifies native inputs/group/multiple Select/image/display elements and delegates format/validation/dataSync. Position-based row/field overloads, reset/default creation and update lifecycle exceed current bind/read basics.
additional_dynamic_paths.acceptance: Distinguish authored-default reset, clear binding, stored-row revert and typed current value creation; cover image/rich displays, grouped fields, nested writes, disabled eligibility, precedence and lifecycle.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: List overloads, editable row Forms, insertion/order/check/reveal
additional_dynamic_paths.observed: List overloads expose selected/check projections, row forms, editing/validation/value updates, position/beforeRow insertion, move/copy, separate multi/check-all state and reveal/resize/progressive scroll policies.
additional_dynamic_paths.acceptance: Preserve all selection/check projection and veto/toggle outcomes, editable row controls, stable identities/order/status, default creation and row cleanup; independently test progressive scroll versus local page size and true virtualization.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: Tree emitted checkbox cascade and label/identity distinction
additional_dynamic_paths.observed: Tree key is the display-label source field, val is identity. Checkbox click cascades descendants, updates checked/mixed parents and emits checked leaf collections. check/val/update sections are commented TODOs, not shipped APIs.
additional_dynamic_paths.acceptance: Cover folder selection, explicit level/parent/root semantics, programmatic/select/expand/collapse projections and native accessible check/mixed state. Preserve emitted cascade/hooks; do not invent uncommented methods from TODOs.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: Alert contextual input/array messages and configured timers
additional_dynamic_paths.observed: Alert supports field/window contexts, message arrays and vars, html content, confirmation/buttons, show/hide/remove retained state and input displayTimeout/closeBtn defaults from external config.
additional_dynamic_paths.acceptance: Implement useful rich/inert authored content, arbitrary/array/contextual messages, optional accessible user-controlled expiry, focus/reveal/modal/nonmodal and hooks. CSS/native top-layer placement can replace mechanics without deleting behavior.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: Date/month/year/holiday and gesture matrix
additional_dynamic_paths.observed: DatePicker adds input show/hide hooks, month-only/year/month panels, bounded years, direct year/month entry, wheel/swipe navigation and recurring/one-time holidays. Locale tables configure labels/date names beyond current ISO-day binding.
additional_dynamic_paths.acceptance: Crosswalk formats/raw values, period modes, min/max years/days, holidays and navigation gestures to an accessible explicit controller; exercise attached input timing, callback phases, disabled days and cleanup.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: Notification overloads, rich action content and optional expiry
additional_dynamic_paths.observed: Notify add accepts plain/rich content and optional function/hash/URL activation; configured timers remove messages. Legacy docs describe overload faults; preserve useful intended workflows while correcting faults.
additional_dynamic_paths.acceptance: Add inert authored rich/actions with explicit trusted callbacks/links, optional user-controlled accessible expiry, stacking/container placement and complete timer/handler cleanup. No rich-content or timer omission is approved.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: Documents SDI/capacity/menu/reveal, legacy faults and history declaration
additional_dynamic_paths.observed: Documents supports SDI/MDI, maxTabs and maxStateful, insertion order, close-all/list menu/reveal, stateless entry state and redirects. Some docs describe ES6 bare-class-call faults. saveHistory is a literal default but no consuming source branch was found.
additional_dynamic_paths.acceptance: Close useful intended document/capacity/menu/navigation outcomes with failure rollback and accessible controls. Trace external history consumers before classifying saveHistory; absence of a branch does not prove unused behavior.

verification.validation: Node JSON/set/AST/hash/ref checks only. Existing tests are cited source references and were not rerun for this UI/Shell P0 audit. Prior column/browser/package/performance gates are neither expanded nor recertified by structural coverage.

Private CSS/browser mechanics may be replaced after reachability/behavior proof. Unrelated unused utilities need separate reachability evidence and are not supported-behavior retirement.

audit_findings.finding: Tree key/val meaning differs from current key(row): label and identity mappings must remain distinct.
Documents saveHistory is declared/literal-only in the inspected preserved source; external history intent remains unresolved and required for closure.
Global/local before hooks do not uniformly veto; actual local/global/value transforms and consumer return effects require acceptance.
Form.bindEvents adds four reachable nested functions beyond twelve NU.ui helpers and the inventory member count.
Rich/action notifications and optional expiry can preserve useful behavior with authored inert content and accessible controls; none is an approved omission.
